figures.title: Moving jumps and continuity points
figures.caption: Solid: point mass at 1/n. Dashed: point mass at zero. At the limiting jump x = 0, the CDF values differ for every n.

figures.title: A shuffle preserves the distribution
figures.caption: The marginal distribution stays fixed while the pairing changes.

figures.title: A continuous sandwich for an indicator
figures.caption: Solid teal: lower ramp. Dotted gold: indicator of (−∞,0]. Dashed plum: upper ramp. The complete limiting argument is in this solution.

figures.title: Centering, scaling and the Gaussian exponent
figures.caption: This is the expansion of one factor ψ(t/√n). The product of n factors tends to exp(−t²/2).

figures.title: Pairing six positions
figures.caption: For a sixth moment, pairings have three free indices. Their order n³ balances the normalization n⁻³. A singleton would contribute a zero mean.

figures.title: Intermediate sums in the replacement proof
figures.caption: The proof runs from all Gaussian inputs to all original inputs. For one replacement, remove the changing slot to form Tₙ,ᵢ; matching means and variances cancels the first two Taylor terms.
